problem: Hostinger CDN may serve stored public HTML before SSH-accessible LiteSpeed/WordPress receives personalized requests.
execution_chain: resolve registered company environment and pin SSH identity
verify canonical WP site home and target URL
verify origin no-store rules and LiteSpeed bypass
issue only a targeted LiteSpeed URL purge when explicitly requested
independently check Hostinger CDN HIT/BYPASS and Cache-Control
if CDN remains HIT for a private context, record WAITING_PROVIDER_CDN_PURGE without claiming completion
non_capabilities: Hostinger hPanel CDN purge is not exposed as an authenticated command by the enrolled SSH account
LiteSpeed URL purge does not invalidate an already stored Hostinger CDN HTML object
Do not infer an original central 313 signed execution receipt from local SSH logs

remediation.provider_action: Purge Hostinger CDN cache for the specific website with an authorized Hostinger provider integration; if no provider authorization exists, keep WAITING_PROVIDER_CDN_PURGE and do not enable shared HTML for personalized pages
remediation.recovery: Recheck independently after provider invalidation; accept PASS only with no sensitive-context CDN HIT
